clue.text: Old vehicle catching horse in accident, almost

indicators.note: the horse word is placed in the shortened accident word, which is said to be catching it
almost means the accident word stops one letter short of its full length

parts.note: a chance is an accident, something unplanned
an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: A vintage coach very nearly crashes into a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'catching' is a link here, restating the picture of the coach holding the horse; the old open coach was used for day trips.
explanation.definitionFit: A charabanc was an early open motor coach used for outings, so it is an old vehicle.

clue.text: Load motor with energy

parts.note: motor is an everyday word for a car
go means energy or drive, as in full of go

explanation.surface: Fuel up the car to get it going.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo is the goods carried by a vessel or vehicle, its load.

clue.text: A reservist group restricted by inflammatory matter, withdrawal of rights

indicators.note: the reservist group is held within the tinder, restricted by it on both sides

parts.note: tinder is dry material that catches fire easily
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A reservist unit hemmed in by agitators loses its civil liberties.
explanation.definitionFit: Attainder was the old legal forfeiture of civil rights and property following a sentence for treason or felony.

clue.text: Plant gaining merit, cultivated in Chinese area perhaps

indicators.note: the reworked letters go in the continent word

parts.note: Asia is an area of which China is one example, hence perhaps

indicators.note: cultivated suggests the letters of merit are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A plant wins praise when grown in a Chinese region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gaining' is only a link; 'Chinese area perhaps' is a definition by example, since China is one part of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is a genus of aromatic plants including wormwood and mugwort.

clue.text: Splashdown is barely noticeable

definitions.meaning: read literally, something dropping into the sea, as a space capsule does at splashdown
idiomatically, an amount so tiny relative to the whole as to make no difference

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means an insignificant amount, and literally describes something falling into the sea.

clue.text: I treat with unction, working round ruler extremities, which should stop scratching

indicators.note: the reworked letters are set round the ruler's outer pair, enclosing them
working suggests the letters are set in motion and rearranged
extremities are the first and last letters of the word ruler

explanation.surface: Someone anoints a patient, working round the edges of a measuring stick, to stop the itching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' is the anagram signal; the outer letters of ruler (R and R) go inside the rearranged fodder. 'with' joins the two fodder words.
explanation.definitionFit: A counterirritant is a substance applied to the skin to produce mild irritation that relieves another discomfort, such as itching.

clue.text: Provide shelter for characters from either direction

indicators.note: the letters of the answer read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Offering someone a bed, spelled the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone up is to give them somewhere to stay, providing shelter.

clue.text: Bloke beheaded in film causing alarm

indicators.note: the shortened name sits in the word for film

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film

indicators.note: beheaded means the name loses its first letter

parts.note: Ian stands for any bloke, a common man's name

explanation.surface: A headless man appears in a horror film and spreads alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: Panic is sudden overwhelming fear, the same as alarm.

clue.text: Body temperature thereabouts

parts.note: or so means approximately, thereabouts

explanation.surface: A rough reading of someone's body temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the trunk of the human body, without the head and limbs.

clue.text: Casanova of Wapping is a catch!

definitions.meaning: a ladies' man among journalists; Wapping in east London is where newspapers such as The Times moved in 1986
a small snap fastener that holds clothing closed

explanation.surface: A newspaper womaniser is quite a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: A press stud is a two-part snap fastener on clothes, a kind of catch.

clue.text: Turner producing old rubbish, nothing bishop should collect

indicators.note: the bishop abbreviation collects the other pieces, holding them between its letters

parts.note: RR is Right Reverend, the title of a bishop
tat is cheap rubbishy goods
O is the round figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A painter churns out dated junk that the bishop wants to collect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' looks like the painter J. M. W. Turner; it is something that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotator is something that rotates, so it is a turner.

clue.text: Psych out to make athlete lose lead — victorious day follows

indicators.note: follows places the day abbreviation after the shortened athlete
lose lead means the athlete word drops its first letter

parts.note: a runner is a track athlete
VE Day was Victory in Europe Day, 8 May 1945

explanation.surface: Trying to rattle a rival, an athlete falls behind and a winning day follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To unnerve someone is to shake their confidence, which is what psyching them out means.

clue.text: Doctor about to inject more unfamiliar drug

indicators.note: the foreign word for more is injected into the reversed doctor
about turns the doctor abbreviation round

parts.note: MO is Medical Officer, a doctor
più is Italian (so unfamiliar, foreign) for more, as in musical directions

explanation.surface: A doctor is about to inject an even stranger drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfamiliar' marks the Italian word for more, familiar from musical directions such as più forte.
explanation.definitionFit: Opium is the narcotic drug obtained from the opium poppy.

clue.text: Explain how to vote

definitions.meaning: to communicate an idea clearly so it is understood
voters mark a ballot paper with an X, so this reads literally as marking an X

explanation.definitionFit: To put across an idea is to explain it, and voting involves putting a cross on the ballot.

clue.text: Those fluctuating in time — beware of them

parts.note: in Julius Caesar the soothsayer warns: Beware the ides of March

explanation.surface: Warning about things that rise and fall over time.
explanation.walkthrough: The ides were the middle days of the Roman month; Shakespeare's soothsayer tells Caesar to beware them.
explanation.definitionFit: Tides rise and fall twice daily, so they are things that fluctuate.

clue.text: Military vessel hard on trail capsizing the end

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Military vessel hard on trail capsizing the end' gives T(ROOPSH)IP only with ROOPSH (H + SPOOR reversed) put inside TIP, and no word signals the insertion; likely a word lost in OCR, not found by search.
annotationWithheld.clue: Military vessel hard on trail capsizing the end

clue.text: Point taken by the alien or the astronaut

indicators.note: the answer is taken by, held within, the run of words alien or the astronaut

explanation.surface: A compass point is claimed by an extraterrestrial or a spaceman.
explanation.definitionFit: Northeast is one of the points of the compass.

clue.text: For pain, try something shaved

parts.note: to hear a case is to try it in court
a tache, short for moustache, is something one might shave off

explanation.surface: A suggestion that shaving might relieve pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartache is emotional pain or grief.

clue.text: An African nation had succeeded in eliminating resistance, which is a relief

indicators.note: the successor letter comes in while the resistance letter is eliminated, a swap

parts.note: Algeria is a North African country
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: An African country triumphed after crushing the rebels, which comes as a relief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had' is a link; S (succeeded) replaces R (resistance) inside the country, with 'in eliminating' the swap signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Analgesia is the relief of pain, the absence of sensitivity to it.

clue.text: University far out involved in different prayer

indicators.note: the university letter and reworked far are involved in, placed within, the word for different

parts.note: other means different

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of far are put out of order

explanation.surface: A student far away takes part in an unusual prayer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges FAR; the university letter and reworked letters sit just after the first letter of the word for different.
explanation.definitionFit: The Our Father is the Lord's Prayer, from its opening words.

clue.text: A lot of cash about right for settlement

indicators.note: the wad of cash goes about, around, the letter for right

parts.note: a wad is a thick bundle of banknotes

explanation.surface: A large sum of money paid out in a legal settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: An award is a sum settled on someone, for example in a legal settlement.

clue.text: Life before Eva, single, though topping

indicators.note: before places the life word ahead of the others

parts.note: pep means vitality, life
Eva Peron was the wife of Argentine president Juan Peron
I is the Roman numeral one, single

explanation.surface: A tale of liveliness preceding Eva's single days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topping' looks like an adjective meaning excellent; it is a pizza topping.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy sausage used as a pizza topping.

clue.text: A fungus climbs new tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbs means the letters read upward, reversed

parts.note: a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcini

explanation.surface: A mushroom grows up a young tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The pecan is a North American hickory tree bearing edible nuts.

clue.text: Message, answer written in green, sent up

indicators.note: in a down clue, sent up means the letters are read bottom to top
the answer letter is written in the colour word

parts.note: lime is a shade of green

explanation.surface: A reply written in green ink is posted upward.
explanation.walkthrough: A inside LIME gives LIAME, which 'sent up' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: An email is an electronic message.

clue.text: Mean to be happy

explanation.definitionFit: Tight means stingy with money, and is also slang for drunk, as happy can be.

clue.text: Material beginning to tear, edges cut sack

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of tear
edges cut means the dismissal word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: to give someone the bullet is to sack them

explanation.surface: Fabric starts to tear and the frayed edges are trimmed from a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sack' looks like a bag; it means dismissal, the bullet, which loses B and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulle is a fine net fabric used for veils and ballet skirts, a material.

clue.text: Area where race gathering community heading for trouble

indicators.note: the race word gathers in the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: to hare is to run fast, race
EC is the European Community

indicators.note: heading for means the first letter of trouble

explanation.surface: A place where a race attracts a crowd, heading for trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race' is the verb hare; HARE takes in EC and T.
explanation.definitionFit: A hectare is a metric unit of area, 10,000 square metres.

clue.text: Charge account finding you and me in a state

indicators.note: the pronoun pair is placed in the state abbreviation

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
us is you and me together

explanation.surface: An account finds the two of us in a sorry state.
explanation.definitionFit: An accusal is an accusation, a charge laid against someone.

clue.text: Punishing, returning by sixteenth route?

parts.note: P is the sixteenth letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: returning means the route word comes back, read backwards

parts.note: a lane is a route, a road or track

explanation.surface: Coming back along a punishing sixteenth road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sixteenth' means the alphabet's sixteenth letter; 'returning' applies to route despite standing apart, and 'by' places the letter beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Penal means relating to punishment, so punishing in sense.

clue.text: Church, unlike cardinal, first to accept me

parts.note: cardinals wear scarlet, so unlike a cardinal is not red

indicators.note: first to means the first letter of accept

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A church, unlike a cardinal, is the first to welcome me.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cardinal' suggests a prelate in red robes, hence 'unlike cardinal' is NOT RED.
explanation.definitionFit: Notre Dame is the famous cathedral church in Paris, and many churches bear the name.
